title: Data Analyst
description:
Experimentation Data Analyst

London (Hybrid) | Up to £60,000

This is an opportunity to join a data-driven organisation where experimentation sits at the heart of decision-making. You'll use advanced analytics, statistical testing, and experimentation frameworks to influence customer and commercial outcomes, working on high-impact projects that directly shape business strategy.

The Company

They are a well-established consumer-facing business with a strong focus on data, analytics, and customer experience. The organisation is continuing to invest in its analytics capability, creating an environment where evidence-based decision-making drives growth and innovation.

You'll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, technical excellence, and the ability to turn data into actionable business recommendations.

The Role

As a Senior Experimentation Analyst, you will design, execute, and evaluate experiments that improve customer engagement, marketing performance, and commercial outcomes.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and delivering robust experimentation programmes across digital and customer channels
  • Applying a range of testing methodologies beyond traditional A/B testing
  • Analysing experiment results and translating findings into clear business recommendations
  • Building and maintaining scalable analytical solutions using SQL and Python
  • Working with stakeholders to identify testing opportunities and prioritise experimentation roadmaps
  • Driving a test-and-learn culture across the business
  • Presenting insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Supporting the development of measurement frameworks and analytical best practices

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on SQL and Python skills are essential
  • Proven commercial experience designing, running, and evaluating experiments from end to end
  • Ability to discuss multiple real-world experimentation projects and their business impact
  • Strong understanding of statistical testing and experimental design methodologies
  • Experience working within retail environments is highly desirable
  • Background in marketing analytics, customer analytics, or digital analytics is preferred
  • STEM degree or equivalent quantitative background is advantageous
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to turn complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations

What They Offer

  • Competitive salary and bonus package
  • Hybrid working model
  • Exposure to high-profile business initiatives
  • Clear progression opportunities within a growing analytics function
  • Ongoing learning and development support
  • Collaborative and data-led culture

How to Apply

If you have strong SQL and Python skills, a passion for experimentation, and enjoy solving complex business problems through data, apply today to learn more
